proof_body:
by
  intro N _ Φ a k
  simp only [ZMod.dft_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [← Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.addRight a) (fun j => ZMod.stdAddChar (a * k) * (ZMod.stdAddChar (-(j * k)) * Φ j))]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← AddChar.map_add_eq_mul]
  simp only [Equiv.coe_addRight]
  congr 2
  ring
target_source: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (Φ : ZMod N → ℂ) (a k : ZMod N), ZMod.dft (fun j => Φ (j + a)) k = ZMod.stdAddChar (a * k) * ZMod.dft Φ k
